notes.title: The Discord server is now online!
notes.content:
An incredible thank you to everyone who tried the demo. I love this project, and seeing people play it and wishlist it is making my year.

The game is still far from release, but I guarantee that I'm putting my heart into this project.
For now, I want to let you know that the [b]Discord server for "The Respawn Banter" is open![/b] It may be a little early, but it may help to gather the persons interested in [b]receiving every update on the development of the game[/b]!

You might also get some [b]insight into the other characters that will appear in the game[/b], together with a chat channel where you can... [b]ask Levenne question[/b]? She doesn't mind that much, don't worry.

[b][url=https://discord.gg/USrZcyBu3k]Join the Discord![/url][/b]

If you're not really a Discord type of person, don't worry! You can still [url=https://twitter.com/RPGWaldorf]follow the development updates on Twitter[/url]! (Levenne will get angry at me if I call it X)
